suppress.notes: Owner: Framework maintainer. The HTTP/SOAP/gRPC mock provider uses WireMock's Apache5 adapter. Its five class files belong to WireMock; Apache HttpClient is a separate scanned JAR (5.6.4). Dependency-Check incorrectly assigns the adapter the Apache HttpClient 4.0.0.44 CPE. Both CVEs concern Apache's library. Verify or remove on the next WireMock upgrade or by 2027-02-23. https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/wiremock/wiremock-httpclient-apache5/4.0.0-beta.44/wiremock-httpclient-apache5-4.0.0-beta.44.pom https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2014-3577 https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2020-13956

Owner: Framework maintainer. The grpc_mock provider bundles wiremock-grpc-extension-core 1.0.0-beta.5. Its 30 classes belong to org.wiremock.grpc and it has no nested JAR. Dependency-Check assigns the extension the WireMock server CPE with version 1.0.0.5. The 2018 CVEs affect the server before 2.16.0. The 2023 CVE was fixed in 2.35.1 and 3.0.3. The published POM depends on wiremock-core 4.0.0-beta.26. The framework bundles wiremock-core 4.0.0-beta.44 as a separate scanned JAR. Recheck this digest and remove the rule on upgrade, on corrected detection, or by 2027-02-23. https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/wiremock/wiremock-grpc-extension-core/1.0.0-beta.5/wiremock-grpc-extension-core-1.0.0-beta.5.pom https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2018-9116 https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2018-9117 https://github.com/wiremock/wiremock/security/advisories/GHSA-pmxq-pj47-j8j4
